decisions.decision: Export button: ExpensesPage header, secondary outlined style, next to + Add Expense

decisions.decision: Export ALL expenses always — no filter applied
decisions.rationale: User can filter in Excel/Sheets after download

decisions.decision: 7 CSV columns: date, category, description, amount, currency, notes
decisions.rationale: REQ-23 spec + user chose to include notes beyond spec

decisions.decision: JWT auth via Axios responseType:blob + programmatic anchor — no token in URL
decisions.rationale: Security best practice, Axios interceptor handles auth header automatically

decisions.decision: Route GET /api/expenses/export MUST be registered before expenses/{id} in api.php
decisions.rationale: Laravel top-to-bottom route matching — export literal would be swallowed as an ID
